anomalies.desc: There is non-zero data between the PE header and the first section

anomalies.name: HighXrefLoopingFunction
anomalies.desc: Function contains a loop and has a lot of incoming references (string decryption candidate)

anomalies.name: HugeFunctionGapAtSectionBoundary
anomalies.desc: There is a huge gap between start/end of executable section and first/last function of a section with medium-to-high entropy (which is not a know structure). It often means that data is stored there

anomalies.name: HugeGapBetweenFunctions
anomalies.desc: There is a huge gap between two functions with medium-to-high entropy, often means that data is stored there

anomalies.name: ManyHighValueImmediates
anomalies.desc: Function contains at least 5 and more than 10% of high-value immediate operands (i.e. immediate values that contains at least 2 non-zero non-FF bytes and are not a valid address)

anomalies.name: ManyUniqueImmediateBytes
anomalies.desc: More than 48 unique bytes defined across all immediate operands in the function

anomalies.name: ResourceDirectoryGap
anomalies.desc: There is a space (bigger than 15 bytes) inside the resource directory region which is not occupied by a resource

anomalies.name: SequentialFunction
anomalies.desc: function with very little intra jumps and calls, usually a crypto function, unrolled loops or data initialisation

anomalies.name: SpaghettiFunction
anomalies.desc: Function with lots of intra jumps, could be obfuscated

anomalies.name: XorInLoop
anomalies.desc: XOR instruction in a loop
